recommendations.reason: 一篇少见的完整迁移复盘：80 万行代码、单人主导、几个月完成，而且把 token 成本、性能前后对比、以及迁移中真实踩到的回归都摆了出来。想在自己仓库里试 agent 大规模改写的团队，可以把它当成一份带数字的风险清单。

多会话共享客户端时吞吐从 7.55 升到 120 个会话生命周期/秒

recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这是目前公开材料里最扎实的一次「AI 主导的大型语言迁移」复盘，价值不在结论多震撼，而在于它把方法、成本和翻车点都写清楚了。

1. 问题从哪来：Copilot 的运行时要被嵌进 Python、Java、C# 等宿主应用，但原实现是 TypeScript 跑在 Node 与 V8 上，每个客户端光启动就要背约 100MB 内存，还要多起一个进程、多监控一个可能崩掉的 Node 进程。改成可被宿主进程直接加载的 Rust 库，动机是资源与可嵌入性，不是追新技术。

2. 迁移怎么切：没有推倒重写后一次性切换，而是在原仓库里逐组件替换。一个组件的 TypeScript 实现和对应的 Rust 实现在同一个 PR 里完成，中间用一层薄包装桥接，旧实现当场删掉，逼着团队只维护一份活代码。顺序按依赖排：先动有强测试、不共享状态的小工具函数，用它们把构建、打包、跨语言调用这条路走通；状态管理、模型客户端、集成依次跟进；最复杂、需要多轮返工的会话编排留到最后。整程目标只有一条：保持原有行为与算法，重构一律推迟到迁移之后。

3. agent 怎么组织：协调 agent 先把大组件读透再拆任务。最典型的是 3 万行的 session.ts，协调 agent 花一小时读代码，然后拆给 15 个子会话，每个子会话有自己的分支和工作副本，最后把改动合回自己的分支。15 个会话同时构建测试直接把开发机压垮，后来改成子会话不做重构建、只在父会话跑，并另开一个会话做构建闸门，一次只放一个构建通过。

4. 代码怎么审：仓库一直在变，所以每一步都要先 rebase 到最新主干，再检查新进来的 TypeScript 改动有没有同步到 Rust——删掉旧文件本身就是一种提示机制，别人再改那个文件就会撞冲突。审查由多个不同模型的 agent 逐行对比新旧实现，重点看行为差异、Rust 实现是否够高效、旧代码与临时包装有没有清干净，以及端到端测试有没有被改动。人只看架构、接口契约和 agent 标出来的风险点。

5. 真实代价：整项工作的 token 费用约 12 万美元（原文为 $120K，约 1360 亿 token，大头是缓存输入），外加其他开发者在集成、打包、构建和评审上的投入。回归也很具体：整数被译成浮点导致某些 SDK 出错，空字符串、时区、替换库的错误处理语义不一致；取消操作没有真正停掉子任务，资源释放过早导致会话卡死；Rust 代码跑到 Node 主线程上把界面冻住；Windows 上缺进程启动参数弹出多余控制台窗口。

我的推荐：值得精读，尤其是准备让 agent 动大仓库的人。三条可以直接抄走：先迁移有测试覆盖的小件来验证整条链路；行为不变优先，别把迁移和重构混在一起；把端到端测试当成唯一的期望行为来源，并且要有机制防止 agent 为了让测试过而改弱测试。

recommendations.title: 1000 个 agent、28.7 小时：多智能体团队重做费马大定理形式化证明
recommendations.reason: Anthropic 把多 agent 协作的工程量摊开讲：1000 个沙箱、一张共享 SQL 数据库、Git 主干验收，以及过程中 agent 如何自己建表分工、如何低估难题又被提醒拉回来。对正在设计多 agent 编排的人，这是一份有具体数字的参考架构。
key_points: 只给 60 条待证命题与 47 条已有引理，不给平台、不给研究员指导
输出 token 只有 9 月那次的三分之一，证明长度约为七分之一
Langlands–Tunnell 一条拆成 2418 个任务、最深 10 层，第 28.4 小时拿下
超过一百万次工具调用，实时监控一次都没有触发拦截
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这篇不是「AI 会做数学」的宣传，而是多 agent 系统的工程记录——它把协调机制、失败阈值和安全边界都写到了可复现的程度。

1. 实验设置：60 条命题（最终定理加 59 个中间里程碑）、47 条 9 月形式化时已证明的引理，外加一句古典路线的提示。没有 Prove2Me 那样的专用平台，没有研究员随时纠偏，只有 1 个 lead 加 999 个 helper 的层级，以及每个 agent 一台无网络的轻量虚拟机。

2. 协调靠自己长出来：开头十分钟，lead 在共享数据库里建了五张表——分工、任务、笔记、公告、结果；写 999 行把每个 helper 指派到一条命题，每组 16 到 17 人，各组指定一个 captain 出计划、拆任务。27 分钟时三条命题已证完，lead 读完成员的难度判断，把 47 条被判「预算内做不完」的命题先放到一边，把人力压到剩下 10 条上，小组从 17 人扩到 46 至 139 人。70 分钟内这 10 条全部完成，lead 随即说「没有理由闲着」，把人调回难题。到第 5.6 小时，73 个 helper 写了 756 个任务，其中只有 16 个是 captain——分工权从 lead 下沉到了执行层。

3. 最硬的一块：Langlands–Tunnell 的 captain 早先估计至少要 70 万到 100 万行 Lean、按时完成概率不到 1%，lead 也承认「胜算不高」，但在第 18 小时把约 750 个 helper 压了上去。任务被组织成树，一块太大就往下拆，最终 2418 个任务、最深 10 层，子任务可以假设下层已成立，于是几百个 agent 能并行推进。第 28.4 小时该命题通过，第 28.7 小时主定理进了主干，Lean 官方检查器验过。

4. 规模化的真实瓶颈与安全：一台共享机器在约 100 个 agent 时就撑不住，100 个 agent 的试跑里超过一半因内存、磁盘或 CPU 耗尽被中止或重启，所以改成一人一台沙箱。安全上是三层：无网络沙箱、逐条工具调用过 LLM 分类器（命中即全队暂停等人复核，防止另一个 agent 接着做被拦的动作）、离线监控复查全队行为。这次实际只启用了基于动作的监控，整场一百万次以上工具调用没有一次达到拦截线，事后用带思维链的监控重放，只有一次检查 root 权限的动作接近边界。

5. 局限：agent 会系统性低估难题——60 条里有 47 条一开始被判做不完，最后大多做出来了；也会提前放弃，需要人或其他机制在关键时刻推一把。作者自己也说，这不能替代领域专用平台，Prove2Me 那类工具在编译与复用人类结果上仍有优势。

我的推荐：做多 agent 编排的人值得精读。最该记住的不是 1000 这个数字，而是三件事：共享数据库加 Git 主干就够撑起千级协作；瓶颈会先出现在单机资源而不是模型能力；监控要能一键停全队，否则拦得住一个动作拦不住下一个 agent。

recommendations.title: AutoCompress：按目标硬件实测约束来压缩大模型
recommendations.reason: 把剪枝的目标从「参数量」换成「目标机器上的实测延迟、吞吐与显存」，并在 vLLM 里校准代价模型。三个部署场景都有对照实验，其中 RTX 5070 那条 4GiB 显存、750ms 延迟的设定，对本地跑模型的人直接可参考。
key_points: 八个基准平均分比 Minitron++ 高 6.57 / 2.35 / 0.57 个百分点（RTX 5070 / 5080 / H100）
架构搜索消耗的 token 反而少 2.0 至 3.3 倍
Nemotron 3.5 Super 从 120B 压到 74B，单张 B200 上 128K 上下文、batch 16 占 178GB
代价模型在目标 serving engine 内测层耗时，用 Nsight 分别量 prefill 与 decode
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这是一篇工程取向很明确的压缩论文——它不追求在固定参数量下刷分，而是先问「这台机器、这个负载、这个引擎，能装下什么」，再让搜索去满足约束。

1. 动机：现有剪枝流程大多给人一个参数预算，再由人去猜这个预算能不能满足延迟和显存。但参数量并不预测延迟：同样的参数，层结构不同、专家数不同、批大小不同，跑在 vLLM 里的时间可以差很远；只按权重加 KV 缓存估显存，还会漏掉执行工作区与运行时缓冲。结果是工程师要反复试错，才能把部署指标翻译成剪枝目标。

2. 方法：把硬件约束直接写进可微架构搜索。搜索空间同时包含全局维度（隐藏层宽度、Mamba 头数）和逐层维度（每层专家数、路由与前馈宽度，宽度可以取零来删层），因此允许不同层保留不同容量，而 Minitron 那类方法要求各层统一。代价模型在目标引擎里测：用约十种层配置拼一个短模型跑一遍，按层边界用 Nsight 分别量 prefill 与 decode 的 GPU 时间，再相加估算整模型延迟；显存则按权重、请求缓存、prefill 工作区和运行时缓冲逐项算，另加一个实测残差项兜底。路由器用 Gumbel-softmax 采样软架构，蒸馏损失加一个只在超出预算 98% 到 100% 区间时才生效的惩罚项。

3. 三个场景：RTX 5070 上的游戏 NPC，4GiB 显存、750ms 端到端、2048 输入 256 输出；RTX 5080 上的本地编码 agent，26 万缓存加 1.6 万输入、11.5 秒、13.96GiB；8 张 H100 的数据中心批推理，每卡 batch 128、8192 输入 65536 输出，目标比父模型吞吐高 50%。

4. 结果：八个基准平均分相对按同样约束改造过的 Minitron++ 分别高 6.57、2.35、0.57 个百分点，蒸馏损失低 19.3%、4.3%、0.6%，而架构搜索用的 token 只有对方的二分之一到三分之一。两个消费级卡上的学生模型实测达标：739.7 毫秒、3.93GiB，以及 11.1 秒、13.61GiB。放大到 Nemotron 3.5 Super，120B 压到 74B（减 38.3%），在单张 B200 上以 BF16 跑 128K 上下文、batch 16 占 178GB，九项基准均值 54.74，父模型 57.58，保住约 95%，比同规模参考模型 Nemotron 3 Super 高 9.30 分。整个搜索加恢复训练用 32 个 GB200 节点跑约 64 小时。

5. 值得挑刺的地方：单层耗时相加仍是近似，层结构变化会改变 kernel 选择与缓存行为，作者只用留出模型验证了误差；H100 那一档收益只有 0.57 个百分点，说明结构统一的场景下逐层异构的空间有限；大模型案例没有跑 Minitron++ 对照，省下的对比只能靠小模型那三组外推。

我的推荐：做端侧或私有部署的人值得读。最实用的一点是方法本身——先量清楚目标引擎在你的负载下的延迟与显存，再把这组数当成搜索约束，比盯着参数量挑模型靠谱得多。
recommendations.full_analysis_md:
一句话判断：这是一篇工程取向很明确的压缩论文——它不追求在固定参数量下刷分，而是先问「这台机器、这个负载、这个引擎，能装下什么」，再让搜索去满足约束。

1. 动机：现有剪枝流程大多给人一个参数预算，再由人去猜这个预算能不能满足延迟和显存。但参数量并不预测延迟：同样的参数，层结构不同、专家数不同、批大小不同，跑在 vLLM 里的时间可以差很远；只按权重加 KV 缓存估显存，还会漏掉执行工作区与运行时缓冲。结果是工程师要反复试错，才能把部署指标翻译成剪枝目标。

2. 方法：把硬件约束直接写进可微架构搜索。搜索空间同时包含全局维度（隐藏层宽度、Mamba 头数）和逐层维度（每层专家数、路由与前馈宽度，宽度可以取零来删层），因此允许不同层保留不同容量，而 Minitron 那类方法要求各层统一。代价模型在目标引擎里测：用约十种层配置拼一个短模型跑一遍，按层边界用 Nsight 分别量 prefill 与 decode 的 GPU 时间，再相加估算整模型延迟；显存则按权重、请求缓存、prefill 工作区和运行时缓冲逐项算，另加一个实测残差项兜底。路由器用 Gumbel-softmax 采样软架构，蒸馏损失加一个只在超出预算 98% 到 100% 区间时才生效的惩罚项。

3. 三个场景：RTX 5070 上的游戏 NPC，4GiB 显存、750ms 端到端、2048 输入 256 输出；RTX 5080 上的本地编码 agent，26 万缓存加 1.6 万输入、11.5 秒、13.96GiB；8 张 H100 的数据中心批推理，每卡 batch 128、8192 输入 65536 输出，目标比父模型吞吐高 50%。

4. 结果：八个基准平均分相对按同样约束改造过的 Minitron++ 分别高 6.57、2.35、0.57 个百分点，蒸馏损失低 19.3%、4.3%、0.6%，而架构搜索用的 token 只有对方的二分之一到三分之一。两个消费级卡上的学生模型实测达标：739.7 毫秒、3.93GiB，以及 11.1 秒、13.61GiB。放大到 Nemotron 3.5 Super，120B 压到 74B（减 38.3%），在单张 B200 上以 BF16 跑 128K 上下文、batch 16 占 178GB，九项基准均值 54.74，父模型 57.58，保住约 95%，比同规模参考模型 Nemotron 3 Super 高 9.30 分。整个搜索加恢复训练用 32 个 GB200 节点跑约 64 小时。

5. 值得挑刺的地方：单层耗时相加仍是近似，层结构变化会改变 kernel 选择与缓存行为，作者只用留出模型验证了误差；H100 那一档收益只有 0.57 个百分点，说明结构统一的场景下逐层异构的空间有限；大模型案例没有跑 Minitron++ 对照，省下的对比只能靠小模型那三组外推。

我的推荐：做端侧或私有部署的人值得读。最实用的一点是方法本身——先量清楚目标引擎在你的负载下的延迟与显存，再把这组数当成搜索约束，比盯着参数量挑模型靠谱得多。

items.title: Two Kinds of Test-Time Scaling (28 minute read)
items.summary: Test-time scaling trades compute for performance at test time. There are two types of test-time scaling: one allows researchers to trade more compute for more performance per task, but only up to the maximum quantity of per-task compute used during training; and the other lets researchers trade more compute for more performance per task, and lets them do so up to quantities of compute and performance that never occurred during training. Scaling methods that permit the latter change will have a larger impact than test-time scaling considered simply. This essay describes how this may impact the world.

items.excerpt: Test-time scaling trades compute for performance at test time. items.title: PHP2Shell — Deep Dive (45 minute read)
items.summary: PHP2Shell is a use-after-free chain that can lead to remote code execution. A crafted multipart request triggers an out-of-memory condition during session.upload_progress processing. PHP's bailout path skips cleanup, leaving stale global pointers in a long-lived worker process. A later request reclaims the freed memory and forges a zend_string length field, causing PHP to return 256 bytes of nearby heap data in a Set-Cookie header. The attacker extracts heap and code pointers, defeats ASLR, forges a HashTable, hijacks pDestructor, and executes a command. The article demonstrates an exploit that targets PHP 8.4.26 Alpine CLI and depends on precise heap grooming.
items.score_reason: PHP2Shell use-after-free 链的深度技术分析
items.highlight: 借 OOM 在 session 处理中留下的过期指针反复做堆布局，先泄漏堆基址再泄漏代码指针，最终伪造 HashTable 把 pDestructor 指向 zif_system 拿到 RCE，但生产环境成功率极低。
items.excerpt: I started writing this research on October 26, 2026, and I'm not entirely sure when I'll finish it. At the time of writing, there is still very little information available about PHP2Shell, particularly when it comes to detailed technical analysis of the vulnerabilities and the exploitation process.

items.title: What objective is reasoning solving? (12 minute read)
items.summary: Reasoning is pathfinding in token space. There are many paths from the problem to a correct answer, and the model traverses each of them with each sample. A path is not guaranteed to converge to the correct answer - it's only in aggregate, over the distribution of paths, do we get a high probability of success. RL training directly raises the success probability. The gains credited to 'thinking longer' come from the search paid for during training rather than at inference.
items.score_reason: 把推理看作 token 空间寻路的理论分析
items.highlight: 把推理看作token空间中的寻路：RL训练只是提高采样落入正确答案集合的总概率，单条思维链并不收敛于正确解，因此不保证忠实，也解释了奖励黑客为何随RL规模增加，推理时长本身并非能力来源。
items.excerpt: There's an intuitive but simplified picture of reasoning: let a model think for longer, and it'll be more likely to be correct. But this picture doesn't seem to explain everything. During RL training, models learn to write longer chains of thought, and they get more accurate as they do.

items.title: Detecting and Responding to AI-Aided and Agentic Attacks (10 minute read)
items.summary: Distinguishing between human behavior, humans assisted by LLMs, and autonomous agents is critical to identifying the type of adversary behind an attack. Agents may also use a map-reduce-like pattern: they fan out information-gathering tasks, then synthesize the results all at once.

items.title: Trusted by Default: Qubole Cross-Account Access Abused in the Wild (8 minute read)

items.title: New Units of Knowledge (8 minute read)
items.summary: Difference will become the valuable scarcity when AI becomes the main producer of content. The value will lie in doing things in a way that AI does not. Cheap variation is not the same as valuable difference. What yields scarcity will be a distinction worth paying attention to.
items.score_reason: 观点文：AI 内容过剩时代的差异化价值
items.highlight: 凯文·凯利认为 AI 让生成变得廉价后，真正稀缺的是有区分度的差异与跨代理协作能力；新的可分享知识单元会是规格、上下文加来源信息的代理间打包，而标准化恰恰使差异得以流通并变得有价值。
items.excerpt: We each have a magic genie that will do whatever we ask of it. So do we still need anything from other people? By the same logic, if everyone else has a magic genie that does whatever they want, why would anyone need something we make?

items.title: Storybook 11 beta (6 minute read)
items.summary: Storybook is a small, development-only workshop that lives alongside your app. It provides an isolated iframe that renders components without interference from app business logic and context, helping developers focus development on each variation of a component. Storybook 11 beta brings official skills and headless CLI tools that let agents iterate autonomously in a smaller package with faster context delivery.
items.score_reason: Storybook 11 beta 功能更新，前端工具链参考
items.highlight: Storybook 11 beta 把组件库变成编码智能体的上下文：官方 skills 与 headless CLI 让 agent 自己写 story、跑测试并生成评审页，包体积还缩小了 25%。
items.excerpt: Coding agents can build UI quickly, but without context a lot of it is slop. Duplicate components. Wrong APIs. Missing states.

items.title: How Product Hunt almost died (14 minute read)
items.summary: Product Hunt needed an acquisition to survive. Markets can change quickly. Assume each consecutive round will be 10 times harder than the last, and know the risks if you're planning to pitch the growth narrative. It only takes one 'yes', so create a wide funnel and find people you can speak to without the mask. Try to divorce your emotions from the outcome.
items.score_reason: Product Hunt 被收购前后的创业复盘
items.highlight: Product Hunt 2016 年增长停滞又没做收入，Ryan Hoover 见了 50 多位 B 轮投资人全被拒，收购也一度落空，最终靠 Naval 牵线卖给 AngelList 才活下来。
items.excerpt: Founders get this question all the time. And we hate it. Things usually aren't going well. And even when they are, our minds burn with self-doubt and anxiety.

items.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia (6 minute read)
items.summary: Investigations into whether Nvidia misled investors are now underway.
items.score_reason: Nvidia 投资者诉讼调查进展
items.highlight: 英伟达因黄仁勋与涉间谍调查的 Alice Huang 的关系遭集体诉讼，律所援引「欺诈市场」理论，指公司「正常往来」的说法误导投资者，4.27% 的股价跌幅成了索赔基数，和解多半由公司及董责险买单。
items.excerpt: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% on Monday, the first trading day after its board said it would investigate CEO Jensen Huang over his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive U.S. intelligence believes was spying for China.

items.title: Writing as a thinking tool (10 minute read)
items.summary: Language lets us externalize some of our thinking, and writing lets us externalize even more of it.
items.score_reason: 写作作为思维工具的方法论短文
items.highlight: 作者用有限自动机与图灵机只差一支笔的比喻说明写作扩展了能思考的问题范围，并以写论文评审、博客串联想法为例，给出五条写作规则，主张在 LLM 时代自己动笔反而成为不断扩大的比较优势。
items.excerpt: In middle school I could not get through long passages no matter how hard I tried. I would read an entire page and find that nothing had registered, so I started taking notes out of desperation.

items.title: When Does the US Become a Net Importer of Tokens? (3 minute read)
items.summary: The US could become a net importer of AI tokens between 2028 and 2030. Domestic capacity can accommodate roughly 2.5x annual token growth, with faster demand growth or canceled data center projects pushing computation overseas.
items.score_reason: 美国 token 进口拐点的算力供需测算
items.highlight: 作者用简单模型推算：若在建数据中心并网延期，美国最快 2028 年将变成 token 净进口国；即便全部按期建成，缺口也会在 2030 年出现，同期 GPU 短租价已从 5 美元涨到 13 美元/小时。
items.excerpt: With AI demand outpacing supply, & domestic data center construction slowing, soon the US will consume more tokens than it produces. A basic model estimates this switch between 2028 & 2030, depending on how many planned facilities get cancelled.

items.title: How AI-assisted development helped us build the new Dropbox experience (8 minute read)
items.summary: Dropbox used AI to trace platform dependencies, prototype integrations, and build shared React components for its web and desktop apps. Scoped agent tasks also delivered 22 accessibility improvements and completed a backlog of 53 test cleanup tasks in a week, with engineers reviewing the results.
items.score_reason: Dropbox 用 AI 改造开发流程的实践总结
items.highlight: Dropbox 复盘 AI 辅助开发：用共享 React 组件把 Web 功能搬进桌面端，Agent 按书面计划改代码并跑测试，一周完成拖欠两季度的 53 项测试清理，交付 22 项无障碍改进。
items.excerpt: For three years, we’ve been working toward a new Dropbox experience that helps people do more with their files, from finding a project decision to getting a folder ready to share. Today, we’re beginning to roll that experience out to customers.

items.title: Why is AI Slop so Frustrating to Read? (6 minute read)
items.summary: AI writing burdens readers when it hides who is acting, uses vague wording, or buries the point in empty statements and misplaced emphasis. This post compares articles and coding discussions using a clarity taxonomy, arguing that these faults matter more than familiar AI signatures such as stock phrases or punctuation.
items.score_reason: AI 文风为何难读的清晰度分类分析
items.highlight: AI 文本难读的根因是可测量的不清晰，作者归纳出三种故障：动作被藏进名词、用词怪异不接地气、重点错位；Claude Code 回复中 78% 句子不清晰，人类论坛仅 11%，口癖并非主因。
items.excerpt: AI slop is frustrating to read because language models are currently, ironically, bad at writing. The language aspect lags behind other capabilities like coding, for these other capabilities are 1) easier to optimize with straightforward rewards and 2) seemingly more economically appealing, at least in the short term.

items.title: The Race to Build a “Find My” for AI Chips (4 minute read)
items.summary: Location verification could help detect advanced AI chips diverted to restricted destinations despite export controls. This article examines efforts to establish where chips are operating as US legislators push for verification requirements.
items.score_reason: AI 芯片位置验证与出口管制的技术博弈
items.highlight: 美国拟立法要求高端 AI 芯片做位置验证：ping 测距、加密主权证书与 GPU 指纹各有局限，只能事后发现挪用，追踪不了离线或在途芯片，物理接触还能伪造信号，成本高且需实地审计。
items.excerpt: In a bid to limit China’s AI capabilities, the United States imposed restrictions in 2022 on the export of certain advanced chips to China. But throughout the AI boom those chips have kept turning up in China anyway.

items.title: Hackers abuse refrigeration controllers to send spam and route proxy traffic (4 minute read)
items.summary: Internet-exposed Copeland XWEB PRO controllers, the ones that run supermarket freezer racks, are being hijacked, most likely through the CVE-2026-25085 authentication bypass, to send coordinated spam and serve as proxy exits.
items.score_reason: 冷藏控制器被劫持发垃圾邮件并充当代理
items.highlight: SecurityScorecard 在九台只发不收的邮件 IP 中确认三台为公网暴露的 Copeland XWEB 冷藏控制器，另有两台分别充当隧道网关和代理出口，疑经登录绕过漏洞入侵。
items.excerpt: Internet-exposed refrigeration controllers used in supermarkets and cold storage facilities are being hijacked and turned into infrastructure for a suspected spam botnet and proxy services, SecurityScorecard has found. The report follows a string of attacks against European refrigeration systems, which Help Net Security started covering in October, when hundreds of French supermarkets had to throw out spoiled stock after attackers took over the systems running their fridges and freezers overnight and switched them to heating.

items.title: New research: Virtual machines remain central to cloud native infrastructure as AI workloads evolve (3 minute read)
items.summary: A Linux Foundation study sponsored by CNCF and Broadcom, covering 492 practitioners, found that virtual machines account for an average of 53% of production applications. Most respondents expect their VM footprint to remain relatively stable as Kubernetes adoption grows. The findings suggest enterprises will continue operating mixed VM and container environments, particularly as AI workloads introduce new isolation requirements.
items.score_reason: 492 人调研：VM 仍承载 53% 生产应用
items.highlight: Linux基金会调查492名云原生从业者：生产应用平均53%仍跑在虚拟机上，71%预计一年内比例不变，34%扩VM源于AI与智能体负载的隔离需求，万人以上企业占比64%，61%团队协同管理。
items.excerpt: Cloud native infrastructure continues to evolve as organizations support an increasingly diverse mix of applications and workloads. While containers and Kubernetes have become important parts of modern infrastructure, virtual machines (VMs) continue to play a significant role in production environments.

items.title: How Cisco Built an Enterprise AI Factory: Scaling Economics, Performance, and Security (5 minute read)
items.summary: Cisco IT built a multi-tenant AI infrastructure platform combining pooled networking, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, rack-level cooling, and integrated security. Cisco reports tripling average GPU utilization from 15% to approximately 50% and expanding its GPU footprint sixfold without adding data center space. The architecture is designed to improve infrastructure economics while supporting enterprise AI workloads at scale.
items.score_reason: Cisco 企业 AI 工厂实践，GPU 利用率从 15% 提升到约三倍
items.highlight: Cisco自建多租户AI工厂：GPU利用率由15%升至约50%（峰值80%），两年GPU从250块扩到1568块而机房不变，80%稳态推理本地运行，支撑9万员工与99.99%可用性。
items.excerpt: Every technology leader faces the enterprise AI paradox: as AI adoption accelerates, organizations run headfirst into external power, cost, and security constraints. Cisco IT proved that infrastructure is the ultimate control point.

items.title: Experimental mRNA therapy promotes repair after heart attack damage (3 minute read)
items.summary: Researchers have developed a treatment that uses mRNA therapy to reawaken heart muscle cells so that they start to divide and help repair damaged muscle. The treatment helped mice produce stronger heartbeats following a heart attack. While not a full cure for heart disease, even small improvements to heart function have been linked to lower mortality. The treatment is short-lived and localized, and is not expected to cause any permanent modification to the heart cells. Further trials in larger animal models are required before human testing can begin.
items.score_reason: 生物医学研究快讯，与工程主题关联弱
items.highlight: 剑桥大学用 mRNA 让小鼠心肌细胞短暂表达 Myc 和 Cyclin T1，心梗后重新分裂，每搏泵血量增约一成，效果维持 12 周且未见副作用，下一步需大动物与人体试验验证安全性。
items.excerpt: Scientists have developed a treatment that 'reawakens' heart muscle cells so they start to divide and help repair damaged muscle. In a study in mice, this produced a stronger heartbeat and increased the amount of blood pumped through the heart with each heartbeat by around 10%, compared with mice that received a mock treatment, following a heart attack.

items.title: chrome-capture (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: Chrome 153+ has a native MP4 tab recorder. chrome-capture records Chrome tabs at 60 to 120 frames per second in up to 2160p straight to an AVI .mp4. The recording includes tab audio. Users can start and stop recording whenever they want. Chromo writes AV1 into the mp4 as it goes.
items.score_reason: 小工具仓库：Chrome 标签页录屏，用途单一
items.highlight: Chrome 新 API 把合成器帧直接写成 AV1 MP4，绕过 JPEG 中继和 ffmpeg，停止录制从 3.8 秒降到 17 毫秒，该包已封装成 CLI 与 Playwright fixture。
items.excerpt: Record a Chrome tab at 60-120fps (up to 2160p) straight to a AV1 `.mp4`. Tab audio too. No ffmpeg. For the past ~decade, `Page.startScreencast` was the only way to get video frames out of CDP.

items.title: The future of software (3 minute read)
items.summary: Software will eventually evolve to the point where it won't mean anything anymore, as everything digital will be instantly created at will.
items.score_reason: 泛论软件未来形态，缺少具体论证
items.highlight: 软件将有三个新常态：everflux 的持续迭代、介于开源与闭源之间的半透明源码、以及人人为自己加功能；agent 每晚把个人改动 rebase 到新版，软件更像持续变异的活物种，不再是发布即完成的成品。
items.excerpt: In the limit, of course, software won’t mean *anything* anymore. Everything digital will be instantly created at will. But in the interim period we’ll wander through an increasingly odd *in-between* age for software. This transition period will be defined by *three new precepts*.

items.title: Exact (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: Exact is an experimental cross-platform runtime that compiles interfaces written in Contract for the web and native hosts, with application logic in TypeScript or Rust. A common set of agent operations supports inspection and testing across platforms, but the project is pre-1.0 and offers no API stability or backward compatibility.
items.score_reason: 实验性跨平台运行时仓库，尚早期
items.highlight: Expo 的 Exact 用声明式 Contract 写界面、TS 或 Rust 写逻辑，同一份代码在 Web、macOS、iOS、Linux 原生渲染，并让 agent 用十个操作自测。
items.excerpt: Exact is a cross-platform application runtime. You describe your interface in **Contract**, a small declarative language, and you write your data logic in **TypeScript or Rust**. The Contract compiler turns the interface into a compact *plan*.

items.title: Reticle (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: Reticle gives coding agents runtime visibility into an app through a development SDK and MCP tools for interactions, network traffic, state, and console activity.
items.score_reason: agent 运行时可见性 SDK 仓库
items.highlight: Reticle 用 dev-only SDK 进入应用内部，让 agent 读网络、状态和 console 验证改动，判定通过、失败或无法判断并附 file:line 定位，通过的流程可复跑为回归。
items.excerpt: Your AI agent says "done." Reticle finds out if that is true. It drives your real, running app and reads what happened. Then it returns a verdict, pass · fail · cannot tell, with the `file:line` to fix.

items.title: The CIO job description is being rewritten in real time (9 minute read)
items.summary: The CIO role is shifting from managing technology delivery toward redesigning business processes and demonstrating measurable outcomes. Technology leaders increasingly face questions about productivity, organizational change, and accountability for AI-driven decisions. Traditional measures such as uptime, project completion, and system reliability remain essential but are no longer sufficient.
items.score_reason: CIO 角色变化的管理层泛论
items.highlight: CIO 角色正被 AI 重写：从按时交付系统转为先追问流程是否该存在、该由人还是智能体来做，并对 AI 结果承担问责，招聘更看重业务判断而非同行业经验，其角色越来越像企业治理者。
items.excerpt: Associates in TIAA’s National Contact Center once worked across a stack of screens that, printed out and lined up, totaled 81 inches. “As tall as LeBron James,” says Sastry Durvasula, who serves as COO for the retirement and investment services provider after years running its technology organization.

items.title: Google Cloud Adds Self-Managed VMware Cloud Foundation on Bare Metal (3 minute read)
items.summary: Google Cloud has launched general availability for a self-managed VMware Cloud Foundation solution on dedicated bare-metal hardware across 22 regions. The new offering gives customers root access across ESXi, vCenter, and NSX, with users driving upgrades and patching using their own portable VCF subscriptions. It complements Google's existing managed VMware Engine, joining similar customer-operated bare-metal options from AWS and Oracle.
items.score_reason: VMware 裸金属自管方案在 22 个区域上线
items.highlight: Google Cloud 上线自管版 VMware Cloud Foundation 9.x：跑在专属 Z3 裸金属、22 个区域，客户拿 root 并自行升级打补丁，与托管的 VMware Engine 并行。
items.excerpt: Google Cloud has announced general availability of a self-managed VMware solution that runs VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) 9.x on dedicated bare metal, giving customers root access across ESXi, vCenter, and NSX in 22 regions. It sits alongside the Google-managed VMware Engine and follows similar customer-operated offerings from AWS and Oracle.

items.title: Google's New TPU Lineup (4 minute read)
items.summary: Google introduced TPU 8i Max for massive context windows and higher compute density, alongside TPU 8tx for secure and confidential inference.
items.score_reason: TPU 8i Max 与 8tx 的规格与场景定位，技术细节完整
items.highlight: 谷歌一年内发布四款第八代TPU：8tx把机密计算下沉到硬件层服务受监管客户，8i Max以双芯片封装翻倍算力、SRAM与HBM带宽应对百万token上下文，并同步开源TorchTPU等软件栈。
items.excerpt: We first designed TPUs more than a decade ago motivated by Google's internal demands, including voice recognition and language translation. Eight generations of TPUs later, the use cases have exploded, covering: i) training and serving our own Gemini models, ii) agentic workloads, iii) delivering services to Google Cloud customers on our cloud infrastructure.

items.title: Update on October 2026 security incident (4 minute read)
items.summary: The security incident involving unauthorized use of internal Fireworks credentials on October 6 has been traced to a financially motivated cybercriminal threat actor group that sells unauthorized access to large language models to illicit routing gateways.
items.score_reason: Fireworks 安全事件一手复盘，含攻击者画像与处置
items.highlight: Fireworks 披露十月入侵后续：攻击者借被攻陷的第三方云主机潜入开发机，账户与账单信息受影响，少数客户的密钥、数据集与未完成模型权重被读取，但默认零数据保留的推理服务未受波及。
items.excerpt: This is an update to our previous security bulletin published on October 9, 2026. In response to the incident, we notified law enforcement and obtained assistance from a leading cybersecurity firm, Palo Alto Networks Unit 42, to help conduct forensic analysis.

items.title: Google DeepMind's AI Agents Make 1024-Bit RSA Keys Cheaper to Attack (2 minute read)
items.summary: Google DeepMind and researchers from UC San Diego and Inria found two ways to reduce the cost of attacking RSA-1024. AI agents cut a signature-forgery attack's CPU time from 1,380 to 391 core-years. They also proposed a batch-factoring method that could make each additional 1024-bit key about 30 times cheaper to factor, though it remains unimplemented. The signature attack needs roughly 4 billion signing queries and does not recover private keys. Modern systems using 2048-bit or larger RSA keys are unaffected.
items.score_reason: DeepMind 用 agent 把 RSA-1024 攻击成本从 1380 降到 391 core-years
items.highlight: DeepMind 的 AI 代理四天内把 1024 位 RSA 签名伪造成本从 1380 CPU 核年降到 391，并给出批量分解每把密钥便宜约 30 倍的方法，仅影响过时的 RSA-1024。
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind says AI agents working under human supervision have found two ways to reduce the cost of attacking 1024-bit RSA cryptosystems. The research, conducted with cryptographers from UC San Diego and Inria, indicates that attacks on legacy RSA-1024 require less computation than previously assumed.

items.title: Introducing Meta Ember (3 minute read)
items.summary: Meta introduced Muse Ember, a small reasoning model optimized for agent tasks such as tool calling, coding, and document parsing. Meta claims it matches Claude Haiku 5.5's highest reasoning score at roughly one-third the cost and outperforms GPT-6 Luna across reasoning settings.
items.score_reason: Meta Ember 小模型发布，主打 agent 工具调用与低成本
items.highlight: Meta 发布最小模型 Muse Ember：输入输出每百万 token 仅 0.1 与 0.5 美元，1M 上下文，自动化与编码 agent 基准超过 Haiku 5.5，但 FrontierCode 仍落后。
items.excerpt: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing.

items.title: Anthropic Buys $3.4 Billion in Gas Generators (2 minute read)
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly secured 1.7 gigawatts of Caterpillar gas generators for $3.4 billion, taking over equipment orders from supplier OnePWR. The purchase moves the AI lab deeper into physical infrastructure as power shortages and lengthy grid connection queues constrain data center expansion.
items.score_reason: Anthropic 采购燃气发电机的算力基建动向
items.highlight: Anthropic 以 34 亿美元买入 Caterpillar 燃气轮机，可发 1.7GW 电，从租算力转向自备电源，以绕开排到 2030 年代的涡轮产能与并网队列，代价是承受气价波动风险。
items.excerpt: AI’s power crunch has become so acute that Anthropic, a company that has generally avoided buying physical infrastructure, is spending $3.4 billion on natural gas turbines. The AI company, which is planning to go public this year, is buying Caterpillar generators that equipment supplier OnePWR had originally ordered.

items.title: The new bottleneck is intent (5 minute read)
items.summary: As AI makes finding and fixing bugs cheaper, deciding what software should do becomes the bottleneck. Real user feedback, simulated users, and deterministic testing each leave gaps in defining expected behavior. This article recommends smoke tests and realistic user journeys, established conventions for minor decisions, and human ownership of product choices.
items.score_reason: 观点：AI 降低实现成本后，意图定义成为瓶颈
items.highlight: 作者认为 AI 让找 bug 变便宜后，瓶颈变成判断什么才算 bug，即生成 intent；真实用户、模拟用户与全量仿真各只覆盖一半，理想系统尚不存在，只能先靠冒烟测试与竞品对齐预期。
items.excerpt: AI has made finding and fixing bugs cheap and efficient. The challenge has moved on to efficiently figuring out what behavior is actually a bug. Deciding that means generating intents: statements of what the product should do.

items.title: On Being an Engineer in 2026: Are We Still Needed? (6 minute read)
items.summary: Engineers retain value through problem framing, judgment, and tacit knowledge shaped by lived experience, even as agents take over more coding, debugging, and architectural work.
items.score_reason: 工程师价值在 AI 时代的再定位
items.highlight: 作者用反证法说工程师仍不可替代：若人真的无用，工程师产出差距该缩小，但 10x 工程师变成了 100x；人的杠杆是经验沉淀的问题定义、复杂度直觉与品味，模型缺亲历经验。
items.excerpt: We all feel it. Every other week, we lose or delegate another part of our work to agents. It started with giving up on writing code. Then it expanded to pretty much any writing - Slack messages, documents, emails.

items.title: QNAP Says Hackers are Breaching NAS Devices in Plex2Shell Attacks (2 minute read)
items.summary: QNAP is urging users who use Plex on a NAS device to update their Plex servers to fix a series of four vulnerabilities, known as Plex2Shell, that are being actively exploited. QNAP states that users should treat their NAS devices and all personal content as compromised if they're running a vulnerable Plex server that is exposed to the public Internet. Users who suspect compromise can upload their logs to the technical support portal for help determining if they have been compromised.
items.score_reason: QNAP Plex2Shell 在野利用，运维需尽快升级
items.highlight: QNAP 确认 Plex2Shell 四个漏洞已被用于入侵其 NAS，仅升级 Plex 1.43.3.10861 无法清除已植入载荷，需按公告自查、重装 QTS 并重置全部凭据及关闭 32400 端口。
items.excerpt: QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server to the latest version available in the QNAP App Center, as hackers are exploiting the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain. The vendor said it had received multiple reports of suspected compromises involving customers’ network-attached storage (NAS) devices.

items.title: SonicWall Warns of New SSL-VPN MFA Bypass Flaw Exploited in Attacks (2 minute read)
items.summary: SonicWall is warning customers of a new vulnerability in SonicOS SSL-VPN devices that an attacker with credentials for an alternate authentication method can exploit to bypass SAML authentication controls, potentially including MFA. CISA added the vulnerability to the KEV list, and the SonicWall PSIRT reported it as potentially exploited. SonicWall also fixed six other vulnerabilities, including two management interface flaws, pre-authentication buffer overflows that could lead to DoS, and weak password hashing vulnerabilities.
items.score_reason: SonicWall SSL-VPN MFA 绕过在野利用预警
items.highlight: SonicWall 修复七个 SonicOS 漏洞，其中 CVE-2026-19868 可绕过 SAML 与 MFA 且已被利用，CISA 限 11 月 20 日前修补，无临时缓解措施。
items.excerpt: SonicWall has released security updates to fix seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS firewalls, including an SSL-VPN authentication bypass flaw exploited in attacks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-19868, allows attackers with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls, potentially including SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

items.title: Default 'admin:admin' Server Password Helps Researchers Hack Two Automakers, Unlock and Start Cars (3 minute read)
items.summary: Researchers accessed ForgeRock/Ping Identity admin consoles at two automakers through an exposed Apache Felix console using the default admin:admin password. They bypassed edge filtering with encoded path characters, gained server access, changed customer credentials, obtained app tokens, and remotely unlocked and started test vehicles.

items.highlight: 两家车企 App 共用的 ForgeRock 身份服务器保留了默认 admin:admin 控制台，研究人员利用边缘与后端路径解析差异绕过拦截，改掉任意用户密码取得令牌，进而远程解锁并启动汽车。
items.excerpt: The login systems behind two car brands' mobile apps could be taken over completely, two security researchers found, allowing them to access any customer's account and, for an owner with a connected car, unlock the doors and start the engine. Both apps signed customers in through ForgeRock, an identity platform now part of Ping Identity, and on those servers the researchers reached an administrator console that still used its default password.
